attributes.powers: Display this card next to a location. While displayed, characters at that location add 2d4 and the Piercing trait to their combat checks. At the end of the turn, each character at that location is dealt 2 Combat damage, then if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 15 check to recharge it instead.
